dedup_comparison.actual_semantics: Cart entity merges contained BE saveWithoutMetadata into entity root and reconstructs correct provider/loadCustomOnly. Destroy kills cart then builds content-bearing cart item before unchecked drop. Crate serializes inventory component but onBEPlaced only restores enchantments and comments vanilla implicit components; inspected cart placement directly calls readTileFromItem then unchecked world insertion. Barrel onBEPlaced explicitly reads fluid component.
dedup_comparison.decision: Related physical custody pattern but different concrete owner and transition: contained moving storage entity/custom components versus whole native spawner world-to-item-to-rebased-world placement. Do not award credit for merely using full metadata instead of a component or for crate/barrel/species variants.

dedup_comparison.actual_semantics: Extractor persists progress/mode/targetSpeed/spawnFailures; vacuum working condition and nearby matching mobs govern paid stage. Completion creates 100-percent entity-type core from underlying spawner, unchecked addFreshEntity then replaces world spawner with empty-spawner. Does not carry complete native spawner metadata back to a newly positioned spawner.
dedup_comparison.decision: Shared spawner resource is not identical mechanism: type-percentage conversion and staged machine checkpoint versus physical full-spawner payload relocation. One narrow Botania custody family supported; no separate item codec/helper/test family.

adjacent_native_comparison.conclusion: Inspected1.20.1 getTagElement reads tag without isEmpty; shrink/grow/setCount only alter count. Zero count therefore does not establish tag erasure or null-copy crash. SpawnerBlockEntity load delegates superclass/BaseSpawner and updateTag omits SpawnPotentials.
adjacent_native_comparison.version_boundary: Botania source snapshot target version not established. 1.20.1 sources are adjacent comparison only, never exact-version validation. No independent BaseSpawner, native context or BlockItem implementation audit here.
